This case-sensitive code system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/hl7-organizational-entity-concept-properties defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
type Organizational Entity TypeA string property for the type of an HL7 organisational entity. Values are 'Work Group', 'Management Group', 'Council', 'Governance Group', 'Affiliate', 'Affiliate Work Group', 'Affiliate Governance Group', 'Product Director', 'Executive'.
status Organizational Entity StatusA string property for the status of an organizational entity. Values are 'active' and 'inactive'.
affiliate HL7 Affiliate concept propertyA code property for the HL7 Affiliate an organization entity may be associated with.
